$comment: Describes every setting in config.jsonc for a settings app. Keys match config.jsonc paths. Keep in sync: python3 tools/check-config.py

types.number: Decimal number. Uses min / max / step / unit.
types.integer: Whole number. Uses min / max / step / unit.
types.string: Free text. With "choices": one of the listed values.
types.icon: File name of an SVG in assets/icons.
types.iconList: List of icon file names; "length" is the expected count.
types.object: Free-form object of overrides; edit as JSON.
types.actionList: List of launcher actions: { title, subtitle, keywords (space separated), icon (file in assets/icons), command (list: program then arguments), confirm (true = press Enter twice) }.
types.command: A command: list of program then arguments. {path} is replaced by the file path, {uri} by its file:// address.
types.integerList: List of whole numbers. Uses min / max / unit for each value.
types.handwriting: File name of an SVG in assets/handwriting: stroked <path> elements and a viewBox, drawn in order.
types.fontFile: File name of a font in assets/fonts, or "" for none.

springFields.label: Response
springFields.description: How long the spring takes to settle, roughly.

springFields.label: Damping
springFields.description: Below 1 it bounces (lower = more bounce); 1 settles without bouncing.

springFields.label: Starting scale
springFields.description: Size the content starts from before it springs to full size.

sections.title: Appearance
sections.description: Fonts and colors used everywhere.

groups.title: Font
groups.description: Text style for the whole shell.

settings.label: Font
settings.description: Font used for all text in the shell. Roundness only works with fonts that have a roundness axis, like Google Sans Flex. The island ships Google Sans Flex (font.bundled), so it is there even when it isn't installed.

settings.label: Bundled font file
settings.description: A font file in the island's assets/fonts folder, loaded when the island starts so the text looks the same on every computer. Empty = only installed fonts.

settings.label: Text size
settings.description: Default text size. Titles and labels that need to stand out set their own size.

settings.label: Text weight
settings.description: Thickness of the text, from thin (100) to black (900). 400 is regular, 600 semibold.

settings.label: Text roundness
settings.description: How rounded the letter ends are, for all text: 0 square, 100 fully round. Only fonts with a roundness axis (Google Sans Flex) change.

settings.label: Text color
settings.description: Default color of all text.

groups.title: Colors
groups.description: Accent colors. Panels pick from these depending on the situation.

settings.label: Main color
settings.description: Color of icons, text and highlights when nothing special is going on.

settings.label: Charging
settings.description: Used for the battery while it charges.

settings.label: Power saver
settings.description: Used for the battery when the power saver mode is on.

settings.label: Balanced
settings.description: Battery color (idle icon and battery panel) in balanced power mode.

settings.label: Performance
settings.description: Battery color (idle icon and battery panel) in performance mode.

settings.label: Warning
settings.description: Used for problems, like a nearly empty battery (idle icon and battery panel).

settings.label: Secondary text
settings.description: Grey used for small captions under or above a title ("Connected", the app name of a notification, the time).

settings.label: Accent
settings.description: Blue used for Wi-Fi alerts and message icons. Used when "Follow the system accent" is off, or when the system has no accent color set.

settings.label: Follow the system accent
settings.description: Use the accent color chosen for the whole desktop (in the settings app, or GNOME's Appearance settings) instead of the one above. Changes show right away.

settings.label: System accent colors
settings.description: The color the island uses for each of the desktop's accent names (blue, teal, green, yellow, orange, red, pink, purple, slate). Brighter than GTK's own, to read well on the dark island.

settings.label: Light fill
settings.description: How light a solid badge's color must be for its icon to turn black instead of white (0-1, by luminance). White on blue and red; black on yellow, green and white.

groups.title: Screen corners
groups.description: Rounds the four corners of the screen, like a Mac display.

settings.label: Round screen corners
settings.description: Paints the four corners of every screen so the screen looks rounded. They stay on top of everything, including fullscreen apps, and clicks go through them.

settings.label: Corner size
settings.description: How rounded the screen corners are. Bigger values cut off more of the corners.

settings.label: Corner smoothness
settings.description: How gently the screen corners curve, like the island's corners (Island > Corner smoothness): the curve starts earlier and blends into the screen's edges. 0 = plain quarter circles. When the media panel fills the screen, the island's corners take this smoothness, so they match the screen's.

settings.label: Fullscreen island overlap
settings.description: When the media panel fills the screen, the island's corners end up this much tighter than the screen's, so the island reaches just under them. Two edges in exactly the same place leave a thin, faint line between them.

settings.label: Corner color
settings.description: Color painted in the corners. Black blends in with the screen's bezel.

sections.title: Bar
sections.description: The strip at the top of the screen that holds the island.

settings.label: Bar height
settings.description: Height of the area reserved at the top of the screen. The island sits inside it.

settings.label: Gap around the island
settings.description: Space between the island and the top edge of the screen.

sections.title: Island
sections.description: Shape and behavior of the island itself.

settings.label: Corner style
settings.description: How round everything is: the island and everything inside it (buttons, badges, rows, tiles, sliders). Square = small corners (never fully sharp). Soft = a bit rounder; the resting island's ends are slightly squared. Round = rounder still, the resting island is a pill, big panels not fully round. Full = the rounded Dynamic Island look: pills everywhere. Each style's corner sizes can be fine-tuned in Corner styles (advanced).

settings.label: Island color
settings.description: Background color of the island.

settings.label: Blur behind the island
settings.description: Make the island see-through and blur what's behind it, like frosted glass. Needs a desktop that supports blur for the top bar (niri does); without it the island is just see-through.

settings.label: Background opacity (blur on)
settings.description: How solid the island's background is when the blur is on. 0 = no color at all: only the blurred background shows, like clear frosted glass. Higher = more of the island color over the blur. 1 = solid color: the blur is hidden.

settings.label: Corner smoothness
settings.description: How gently the island's corners curve, like Apple's Dynamic Island. 0 = off: plain round corners, drawn more cheaply (good for older laptops). Higher = the curve starts earlier and blends into the straight edges. Pill-shaped islands stay plain half circles.

settings.label: Corner change
settings.description: How long the island's corners take to change when a pop-up rounds them differently (the screenshot rounds them more).

settings.label: Attach to the top of the screen
settings.description: Glue the island to the top edge of the screen, like a notch: no gap above it, square top, and curved corners that join it to the screen edge as if the screen wraps around it.

settings.label: Minimum width
settings.description: The island is never narrower than this.

settings.label: Maximum height
settings.description: Room reserved for the tallest panel, bounce included. Raise it if a panel gets cut off at the bottom.

groups.title: Corner styles
groups.description: The corner sizes of each Corner style, in pixels. Change these to fine-tune a style.

settings.label: Square: Island corner
settings.description: The island's corners. Never more than half its height: above that, the island is a pill. Used by the Square corner style.

settings.label: Square: Bottom corners (attached)
settings.description: The island's bottom corners when it's attached to the top of the screen. Never more than half its height. Used by the Square corner style.

settings.label: Square: Edge curves (attached)
settings.description: The inward curves joining the attached island to the top edge of the screen. Used by the Square corner style.

settings.label: Square: Buttons and bars
settings.description: Buttons, the list pill, the volume bar, the search field and the round close buttons. Never more than half their height: 100 = always fully round. Used by the Square corner style.

settings.label: Square: List highlights
settings.description: The highlight behind the selected row in the Wi-Fi, Bluetooth and search lists. Used by the Square corner style.

settings.label: Square: Tiles and pictures
settings.description: The tile behind launcher icons and notification pictures. Used by the Square corner style.

settings.label: Square: Small keys
settings.description: The little Enter key in the launcher. Also the smallest corner anything gets: badges and the idle island's hover pills follow the island's own corner (its corner minus the gap between them), but never go below this. Used by the Square corner style.

settings.label: Soft: Island corner
settings.description: The island's corners. Never more than half its height: above that, the island is a pill. Used by the Soft corner style.

settings.label: Soft: Bottom corners (attached)
settings.description: The island's bottom corners when it's attached to the top of the screen. Never more than half its height. Used by the Soft corner style.

settings.label: Soft: Edge curves (attached)
settings.description: The inward curves joining the attached island to the top edge of the screen. Used by the Soft corner style.

settings.label: Soft: Buttons and bars
settings.description: Buttons, the list pill, the volume bar, the search field and the round close buttons. Never more than half their height: 100 = always fully round. Used by the Soft corner style.

settings.label: Soft: List highlights
settings.description: The highlight behind the selected row in the Wi-Fi, Bluetooth and search lists. Used by the Soft corner style.

settings.label: Soft: Tiles and pictures
settings.description: The tile behind launcher icons and notification pictures. Used by the Soft corner style.

settings.label: Soft: Small keys
settings.description: The little Enter key in the launcher. Also the smallest corner anything gets: badges and the idle island's hover pills follow the island's own corner (its corner minus the gap between them), but never go below this. Used by the Soft corner style.

settings.label: Round: Island corner
settings.description: The island's corners. Never more than half its height: above that, the island is a pill. Used by the Round corner style.

settings.label: Round: Bottom corners (attached)
settings.description: The island's bottom corners when it's attached to the top of the screen. Never more than half its height. Used by the Round corner style.

settings.label: Round: Edge curves (attached)
settings.description: The inward curves joining the attached island to the top edge of the screen. Used by the Round corner style.

settings.label: Round: Buttons and bars
settings.description: Buttons, the list pill, the volume bar, the search field and the round close buttons. Never more than half their height: 100 = always fully round. Used by the Round corner style.

settings.label: Round: List highlights
settings.description: The highlight behind the selected row in the Wi-Fi, Bluetooth and search lists. Used by the Round corner style.

settings.label: Round: Tiles and pictures
settings.description: The tile behind launcher icons and notification pictures. Used by the Round corner style.

settings.label: Round: Small keys
settings.description: The little Enter key in the launcher. Also the smallest corner anything gets: badges and the idle island's hover pills follow the island's own corner (its corner minus the gap between them), but never go below this. Used by the Round corner style.

settings.label: Full: Island corner
settings.description: The island's corners. Never more than half its height: above that, the island is a pill. Used by the Full corner style.

settings.label: Full: Bottom corners (attached)
settings.description: The island's bottom corners when it's attached to the top of the screen. Never more than half its height. Used by the Full corner style.

settings.label: Full: Edge curves (attached)
settings.description: The inward curves joining the attached island to the top edge of the screen. Used by the Full corner style.

settings.label: Full: Buttons and bars
settings.description: Buttons, the list pill, the volume bar, the search field and the round close buttons. Never more than half their height: 100 = always fully round. Used by the Full corner style.

settings.label: Full: List highlights
settings.description: The highlight behind the selected row in the Wi-Fi, Bluetooth and search lists. Used by the Full corner style.

settings.label: Full: Tiles and pictures
settings.description: The tile behind launcher icons and notification pictures. Used by the Full corner style.

settings.label: Full: Small keys
settings.description: The little Enter key in the launcher. Also the smallest corner anything gets: badges and the idle island's hover pills follow the island's own corner (its corner minus the gap between them), but never go below this. Used by the Full corner style.

groups.title: Layout
groups.description: Spacing inside the idle island.

settings.label: Clock to icons gap
settings.description: Smallest space between the clock and the status icons. Smaller means a narrower island that grows more often.

settings.label: Icon spacing
settings.description: Space between the status icon pills. 0 by default: the pills only show on hover, so a gap would just be dead space between them.

settings.label: Pill inset
settings.description: Space between the idle island's pills (clock and status icons) and its edge, on every side.

settings.label: Pill padding
settings.description: Space on each side of an icon inside its pill.

settings.label: Icon reveal tolerance
settings.description: How close an icon's space must be to fully open (in pixels) before the icon fades in. A new status icon first makes room for itself, then appears; a higher value lets it start appearing slightly earlier.

settings.label: Close delay
settings.description: How long the island stays open after the mouse leaves it.

settings.label: Hold before shrinking
settings.description: When switching panels, how long the island keeps its size before shrinking. 0 (default) starts shrinking right away, which feels the most responsive; a small hold lets the old content visibly shrink first, but makes closing feel laggy.

settings.label: Icon fade
settings.description: How long a status icon takes to fade in or out when it appears or disappears.

settings.label: Switch window
settings.description: Size changes within this time after switching panels count as part of the switch (and get the hold before shrinking). Later changes, like search results updating, resize right away.

settings.label: Click outside to close
settings.description: Clicking anywhere outside the island closes the open panel right away, instead of waiting for it to close by itself or pressing Escape. That click only closes the panel: it doesn't reach the app underneath. Over a fullscreen app (a video, a game) the click goes to the app instead, so use Escape there.

settings.label: Clicked panels take the keyboard
settings.description: When you open a panel by clicking the island, it takes the keyboard right away, so Escape closes it without clicking inside it first. While it's open, what you type goes to the panel instead of your app; your app gets the keyboard back as soon as the panel closes. Off: your app keeps the keyboard until you click inside the panel.

settings.label: Key hold safety limit
settings.description: After Escape or Enter closes a panel, the island keeps the keyboard until you let go of the key, so the key isn't passed to the window behind (e.g. a fullscreen video). This is the longest it will wait.

settings.label: Priority order
settings.description: What wins when several things want the island at once, most important first. Anything covered keeps its time and comes back afterwards: a notification that arrives while you're in a panel waits until you close it. The default puts what you do before what the system does. Names: volume, brightness, microphone (the key you just pressed), headphones (you plugged them in), charging (you plugged the charger in), screenshot (you just took one), panel (a panel you opened: search, battery, Wi-Fi), nowPlaying (music started), lowBattery, criticalNotification, wifiConnected, message, notification, lowNotification.

settings.label: Time left after hovering
settings.description: Hovering the island keeps the volume, brightness or a notification up. When the mouse leaves, it stays at least this long.

sections.title: Animation
sections.description: How the island and its content move.

groups.title: Island springs
groups.description: The island moves on springs. Response is roughly the duration in seconds; damping 1 means no bounce, lower bounces more.

settings.label: Grow
settings.description: Spring used when the island gets bigger (wider and taller). Lower damping bounces more. niri's window-open animation mirrors it (~/.config/niri/config.kdl).

settings.label: Shrink
settings.description: Spring used when the island gets smaller, in both directions.

settings.label: Grow to fullscreen
settings.description: Spring used when the island grows to fill the screen (the media panel's fullscreen). Slower than Grow: it travels much further. Lower damping bounces more.

settings.label: Shrink from fullscreen
settings.description: Spring used when the island comes back from filling the screen.

groups.title: Content transition
groups.description: How content swaps when you switch panels.

settings.label: Content fade in
settings.description: How long new content takes to fade in and come into focus.

settings.label: Opacity share of fade in
settings.description: How far through the fade in the content is fully opaque. The blur keeps clearing after that.

settings.label: Pop-up animations start
settings.description: How far through the fade in a pop-up's own little animation starts (the microphone's wiggle, the charging battery filling, the Wi-Fi bars lighting up, the headphones bouncing in). Starting earlier plays part of it while it's still faded or blurred. Fully opaque comes at "Opacity share of fade in"; most of the blur is gone by 75 %.

settings.label: Start fading in at
settings.description: How grown the island must be (compared to its final size) before new content starts to appear.

settings.label: Content fade out
settings.description: How long old content takes to fade out while the island changes. It fades fast at first and eases out, so closing reacts immediately.

settings.label: Overlap
settings.description: How visible the old content may still be when the new content starts. 0 = strictly one after the other.

settings.label: Shrink of old content
settings.description: Size the old content shrinks to while it fades out.

settings.label: Old content follows island
settings.description: How strongly old content shrinks with the island. 0 = keeps its size and gets cut off, 1 = always fits inside.

settings.label: Maximum stretch
settings.description: How much bigger than normal content may get when the island bounces past its size.

settings.label: Minimum appearing size
settings.description: The smallest a panel's content can look while it appears. Content follows the island as it grows; raising this makes it start bigger instead of growing from tiny (the island's edge crops it until there's room). 0 = always follow the island.

settings.label: Blur strength
settings.description: How blurry content gets while it fades. 0 turns the blur off.

settings.label: Maximum blur radius
settings.description: Blur radius at full strength.

settings.label: Fade out blur curve
settings.description: Below 1 the blur kicks in early when content leaves; 1 grows it evenly.

settings.label: Pop start size
settings.description: Size new content starts at before it bounces to full size when a panel opens.

settings.label: Pop spring
settings.description: Spring of the bounce when a panel opens. Only response and damping are used.

groups.title: Small animations
groups.description: Hover, press and color changes.

settings.label: Color change
settings.description: How long color changes take, e.g. the battery panel switching to green when charging.

settings.label: Hover fade
settings.description: How long hover highlights take to appear and disappear.

settings.label: Pressed size
settings.description: Size of a button while it is pressed.

settings.label: Press animation
settings.description: How long a button takes to shrink and grow back when pressed.

settings.label: Settle after opening
settings.description: Once a panel has opened, how long its content takes to stop following the island size.

sections.title: Pop-ups
sections.description: The shared look of everything that pops up in the island (volume, microphone, alerts, messages), so they feel like one family.

settings.label: Edge padding
settings.description: Space between the island edge and text or glyphs at either end of a pop-up.

settings.label: Badge inset
settings.description: Space around a round badge sitting at the end of a pop-up (the microphone, the message icon). Keeps the badge following the curve of the island.

settings.label: Spacing
settings.description: Space between a glyph or badge and the text next to it.

settings.label: Two-line height
settings.description: Height of pop-ups that show two lines, like "Connected" above a device name. One-line pop-ups are as tall as the resting island.

settings.label: Title size
settings.description: Size of the main text in pop-ups (device name, "Low Battery", the message).

settings.label: Caption size
settings.description: Size of the small grey line above a title ("Connected").

settings.label: Line spacing
settings.description: Space between a caption and its title.

settings.label: Badge glyph size
settings.description: Size of the icon inside a round badge.

settings.label: Badge fill
settings.description: How visible the soft background of a badge is (0 = invisible, 1 = solid color).

settings.label: Badge fill on hover
settings.description: Badge background when the mouse is over a clickable badge.

groups.title: Badge with a word
groups.description: A badge that carries a word next to its glyph (the screenshots panel's "Copied" tag) widens into a capsule.

settings.label: Text size
settings.description: Size of the word.

settings.label: Gap
settings.description: Space between the glyph and the word.

settings.label: Padding
settings.description: Space at each end of the capsule.

sections.title: Panels
sections.description: The shared look and motion of the battery, Wi-Fi and Bluetooth panels, so they feel like one family.

settings.label: Width
settings.description: Width of the battery, time, Wi-Fi and Bluetooth panels (one width: switching between them only changes the island's height).

settings.label: Padding
settings.description: Space between a panel's edge and its content.

settings.label: Name size
settings.description: Size of the name on top of the Wi-Fi and Bluetooth panels (the network, the device).

settings.label: Gap under the name
settings.description: Space between that name and the big symbol under it.

settings.label: Rows before scrolling
settings.description: How many networks or devices show at once when a list is open; more scroll.

groups.title: Big number
groups.description: The top of the battery and time panels: the big number (percentage, time), the small grey part beside it (% sign, seconds) and the grey line under it (time left, month). Both panels share these, so they look alike.

settings.label: Size
settings.description: Size of the big number: the battery percentage, the time.

settings.label: Weight
settings.description: Thickness of the big number (100 = thin, 400 = regular, 700 = bold).

settings.label: Small part size
settings.description: Size of the grey part beside the big number: the % sign, the seconds.

settings.label: Rolling time
settings.description: How long a digit takes to roll to the next one when the number changes.

settings.label: Rolling fade
settings.description: How quickly a digit fades while it rolls to the next one. Higher = it disappears sooner.

settings.label: Rolling distance
settings.description: How far a rolling digit slides, in digit heights.

settings.label: Grey line size
settings.description: Size of the grey line under the big number (time left on the battery, month and year).

settings.label: Grey line gap
settings.description: Space between the big number and the grey line under it.

groups.title: Gauge
groups.description: The curved bar of the battery and time panels.

settings.label: Gap above
settings.description: Space between the number (or the grey line under it) and the gauge.

settings.label: Gap below
settings.description: Space between the gauge and what's under it (the power saver button, the week).

settings.label: Thickness
settings.description: How thick the curved bar is.

settings.label: Curve
settings.description: How much the bar curves: how far its middle rises above its ends. 1 = almost flat.

settings.label: Empty part opacity
settings.description: How visible the empty part of the bar is.

settings.label: Tick width
settings.description: Thickness of each mark.

settings.label: Tick length
settings.description: Length of each mark.

settings.label: Tick opacity
settings.description: How visible the marks on the empty part are.

settings.label: Bright tick opacity
settings.description: How visible the brighter ticks are on the empty part.

settings.label: Tick opacity on the fill
settings.description: How visible the marks are on the filled part (they're cut into the color).

settings.label: Opening sweep
settings.description: How the bar fills up from empty when its panel opens (and moves when the value changes). Lower damping bounces more.

settings.label: Sweep delay
settings.description: Wait after the panel opens before the bar fills up, so it plays once the panel is visible.

groups.title: Big symbol
groups.description: The Wi-Fi and Bluetooth panels' big symbol (each panel sets its own shape and size).

settings.label: Unlit opacity
settings.description: How visible the symbol's unlit parts are (all of it while off or not connected).

settings.label: Hover brightness
settings.description: How much brighter the symbol gets under the pointer (it's the on/off switch).

settings.label: Light-up duration
settings.description: How long a symbol takes to light up (part after part) when its panel opens or something connects, and to go out when it turns off or disconnects.

settings.label: Light-up delay
settings.description: Wait after the panel opens before the symbol lights up, so it plays once the panel is visible (not hidden by the island growing).

settings.label: Light-up delay between parts
settings.description: How much later each part of a symbol lights than the one before it (share of the light-up). 0 = all at once.

settings.label: Searching ripple
settings.description: How long one ripple takes to run through a symbol while searching (for networks, for devices).

settings.label: Connecting ripple
settings.description: Same, faster, while connecting.

settings.label: Ripple brightness
settings.description: How much brighter a part gets as the ripple passes.

settings.label: Ripple width
settings.description: How many parts (dot, arcs) the ripple's glow spreads over.

settings.label: Failure shake
settings.description: How far a symbol shakes sideways when connecting fails.

settings.label: Failure shake duration
settings.description: How long the shake lasts.

settings.label: Failure flash
settings.description: How long a symbol stays red after a failed attempt.

settings.label: Name change
settings.description: How long a new name (network, device) takes to roll in.

settings.label: Name roll distance
settings.description: How far the old name slides up and the new one comes from, in text heights.

groups.title: List pill
groups.description: The Wi-Fi and Bluetooth lists: shown right away, or behind a pill that unfolds them.

settings.label: Fold the lists behind a pill
settings.description: Off: the Wi-Fi and Bluetooth panels show their networks / devices right away. On: a pill ("Networks · 6") under the symbol unfolds them when clicked (calmer, one more click).

settings.label: Gap above the list
settings.description: Space between the Wi-Fi / Bluetooth symbol and its list when the list isn't folded behind a pill.

settings.label: Arrow icon
settings.description: The arrow after the text (it turns over when the list is open).

settings.label: Gap above
settings.description: Space between the symbol and the pill.

settings.label: Height
settings.description: Height of the pill.

settings.label: Side padding
settings.description: Space on each side inside the pill.

settings.label: Text size
settings.description: Size of the pill's text.

settings.label: Arrow size
settings.description: Size of the arrow.

settings.label: Arrow gap
settings.description: Space between the text and the arrow.

settings.label: Opacity
settings.description: How visible the pill's background is.

settings.label: Hover opacity
settings.description: How visible the pill's background is under the pointer.

settings.label: Gap between the pill and the list
settings.description: Space between the pill and the list it unfolds.

groups.title: Lists
groups.description: The Wi-Fi and Bluetooth panels' lists of networks and devices.

settings.label: Scroll edge fade
settings.description: Height of the fade at the top or bottom of the list when there are more networks to scroll to. 0 = no fade.

settings.label: Keyboard scroll speed
settings.description: How long the list takes to scroll to the network picked with the arrow keys.

settings.label: Section title height
settings.description: Height of the group titles ("Saved networks", "My devices").

settings.label: Space between groups
settings.description: Space above the second group.

settings.label: Row height
settings.description: Height of each network in the list.

settings.label: Row padding
settings.description: Space inside a row, between its parts and around them.

settings.label: Highlight visibility
settings.description: How visible the highlight behind the selected row is: the Wi-Fi and Bluetooth lists, the launcher's results, and the quick settings keyboard highlight and power menu.

settings.label: Highlight motion
settings.description: How the highlight moves to the row under the mouse or picked with the arrow keys: the Wi-Fi and Bluetooth lists, the launcher, the quick settings keyboard highlight and power menu.

settings.label: Signal icon size
settings.description: Size of the icon at the start of each row (signal bars, device kind).

settings.label: Status text size
settings.description: Size of the status text at the right of a row ("Connecting…", the battery %).

settings.label: Status gap
settings.description: Space between the status, the lock and the check at the right of a network.

settings.label: Connected icon
settings.description: Icon marking the connected network / device.

settings.label: Connected icon size
settings.description: Size of that check.

groups.title: Buttons
groups.description: Labelled buttons in the panels (the battery panel's "Power saver").

settings.label: Height
settings.description: Height of a labelled button.

settings.label: Padding (icon side)
settings.description: Space between the button's start and its icon. A little less than the text side: an icon looks heavier than text, so equal padding looks lopsided.

settings.label: Padding (text side)
settings.description: Space between the label and the button's end (both ends when there's no icon).

settings.label: Icon size
settings.description: Size of the icon before the label.

settings.label: Icon gap
settings.description: Space between the icon and the label.

settings.label: Text size
settings.description: Size of the label.

sections.title: Idle island
sections.description: The resting island: clock and status icons.

settings.label: Date format
settings.description: How the date is written. d = day, M = month (MMM = Jan), yyyy = year, ddd = weekday. Leave empty to show only the time (the full date is in the time panel: click the clock).

settings.label: Time format (24 h)
settings.description: How the time is written on a 24-hour clock. HH = hours (00-23), mm = minutes, ss = seconds.

settings.label: Time format (12 h)
settings.description: How the time is written on a 12-hour clock. h = hours (1-12), mm = minutes, AP = AM / PM (left out by default, like on a phone). Which of the two formats shows is set in the time panel's "24-hour clock" settings.

settings.label: Date to time gap
settings.description: Space between the date and the time.

settings.label: Fixed-width digits
settings.description: Gives every digit the same width, so the island doesn't change size slightly each time the minute changes. Turn off for the font's natural, proportional digits.

settings.label: Empty part opacity
settings.description: Opacity of the empty part of the battery and Wi-Fi icons, and of secondary text.

settings.label: Hover highlight
settings.description: Opacity of the pill shown behind a clickable icon on hover.

settings.label: Icon pop-in size
settings.description: Size a status icon starts at when it appears.

settings.label: Show Bluetooth icon
settings.description: Shows a Bluetooth icon in the idle island while a device is connected (headphones and speakers included). Click it to open the Bluetooth panel.

settings.label: Bluetooth icon size
settings.description: Size of the Bluetooth icon in the idle island.

settings.label: Bluetooth icon
settings.description: Icon shown in the idle island while a Bluetooth device is connected.

settings.label: Wi-Fi icon size
settings.description: Size of the Wi-Fi icon.

settings.label: Wi-Fi icons
settings.description: Icon files for 1, 2 and 3 bars, in assets/icons.

settings.label: Battery icon size
settings.description: Size of the battery icon (in the idle island and the charging alert).

settings.label: Battery icon
settings.description: Icon file in assets/icons.

settings.label: Charging bolt
settings.description: While charging, a small bolt sits on the battery's right end, cut into it, and the battery keeps its usual color (white, or yellow with power saver) instead of turning green.

settings.label: Charging icon
settings.description: Icon cut into the battery while charging.

settings.label: Charging icon size
settings.description: Size of the charging bolt.

settings.label: Power saver plus
settings.description: While power saver is on (and not charging), a small plus sits on the battery's right end, cut into it.

settings.label: Power saver icon
settings.description: Icon cut into the battery while power saver is on.

settings.label: Power saver icon size
settings.description: Size of the power saver plus.

settings.label: Icon position
settings.description: Where the bolt or plus is centred, from the battery's right end (its little nub): negative = further in, over the body.

settings.label: Icon cut-out
settings.description: Empty space cut into the battery around the bolt or plus, so the two don't touch.

settings.label: Icon fade
settings.description: How long the bolt or plus takes to fade in or out.

settings.label: Icon bounce start
settings.description: Size the bolt or plus starts at before it bounces in.

settings.label: Icon bounce
settings.description: Spring of the bolt's or plus's bounce when it appears. Lower damping bounces more.

settings.label: Low battery warning
settings.description: At or below this charge (and not plugged in), the battery turns the warning color, in the idle icon and the battery panel. Charging and power saver colors still win.

settings.label: Middle opens quick settings
settings.description: Clicking the empty middle of the resting island (between the clock and the icons) opens quick settings. Nothing marks it, to keep the island clean.

groups.title: Music
groups.description: The little bars that show while music plays (and a while after); click them for the media panel.

settings.label: Show
settings.description: Show the music bars in the idle island while something plays.

settings.label: On the left
settings.description: Put the music bars on the left, right after the clock (what's going on at the left, the computer's status at the right). Off: with the status icons on the right.

settings.label: Stay after pausing
settings.description: After the music is paused or finished, the bars stay (still) this long, so you can click them and start it again from the media panel. 0 = they go at once.

settings.label: Cover color
settings.description: Color the bars like the album cover instead of white (the media panel and the music alert always use the cover's color).

settings.label: Animate
settings.description: Let the bars dance while music plays. Off = still bars (no drawing at all while the island rests).

settings.label: Bars
settings.description: How many bars.

settings.label: Bar width
settings.description: Width of each bar.

settings.label: Gap
settings.description: Space between the bars.

settings.label: Height
settings.description: Height of the bars at their tallest.

settings.label: Idle transition overrides
settings.description: Transition settings that apply only to the idle island. Same keys as Animation > Content transition.

sections.title: Battery panel
sections.description: Opens when you click the battery icon.

groups.title: Ticks
groups.description: The marks along the bar.

settings.label: Ticks
settings.description: How many marks along the bar, from 0 to 100 %. 21 = one every 5 %.

settings.label: Bright tick every
settings.description: Every how many marks one is brighter. 5 with 21 marks = 0, 25, 50, 75 and 100 %.

groups.title: Percentage
groups.description: The number on top of the panel.

settings.label: % sign gap
settings.description: Space between the number and the % sign.

groups.title: Time estimate
groups.description: In grey under the percentage: how long until the battery is full while charging, how long it will last otherwise.

settings.label: Text
settings.description: The line under the percentage while charging; %1 is the time left (as below).

settings.label: Text on battery
settings.description: The line under the percentage when not charging; %1 is how long the battery will last (as below).

settings.label: Hours format
settings.description: The time when it's an hour or more: %1 = hours, %2 = minutes. "%1:%2" would read like a clock.

settings.label: Minutes format
settings.description: The time when it's under an hour: %1 = minutes.

groups.title: Power saver button
groups.description: The labelled button under the bar: soft, or solid yellow while power saver is on; Space toggles it too. Its size: Panels → Buttons.

settings.label: Icon
settings.description: Icon before the label on the power saver button.

settings.label: Label
settings.description: The power saver button's label.

groups.title: In the launcher
groups.description: How the battery panel appears when you search for it.

settings.label: Title
settings.description: Name of the battery panel in search results.

settings.label: Description
settings.description: Short text shown on the right of the result.

settings.label: Keywords
settings.description: Extra words (separated by spaces) that also find this panel.
settings.default: power energy charge eco performance saver

settings.label: Icon
settings.description: Icon file in assets/icons shown next to the result.

settings.label: Battery transition overrides
settings.description: Transition settings that apply only to the battery panel. Same keys as Animation > Content transition.

sections.title: Wi-Fi panel
sections.description: Opens when you click the Wi-Fi icon. Content still to be designed.

groups.title: Layout
groups.description: The Wi-Fi panel's own texts (size, motion and the list pill are shared: Panels section).

settings.label: Off text
settings.description: Shown in grey instead of a name while it's off: a hint that the big symbol under it is the switch.

settings.label: List pill text
settings.description: Text of the pill; %1 is the number of networks found.

groups.title: Wi-Fi symbol
groups.description: The big Wi-Fi symbol: the small Wi-Fi icon's dot and two arcs, redrawn with its own proportions and scaled up, lit in blue up to the signal (the dot is the first bar). Click it to turn Wi-Fi on or off.

settings.label: Size
settings.description: How big the symbol is: pixels per unit of the small icon's 24-unit grid (4.5 = about 75 px tall).

settings.label: Dot radius
settings.description: Radius of the dot, in icon units (the small Wi-Fi icon's 24-unit grid). The icon's own is 2.5; a little smaller here because a solid dot looks bigger than it is next to thin arcs at this size.

settings.label: Arc thickness
settings.description: Thickness of the arcs, in icon units (the small Wi-Fi icon's 24-unit grid).

settings.label: Inner arc radius
settings.description: Radius of the inner arc's centre line, in icon units (the small Wi-Fi icon's 24-unit grid).

settings.label: Outer arc radius
settings.description: Radius of the outer arc's centre line, in icon units (the small Wi-Fi icon's 24-unit grid).

settings.label: Dot height
settings.description: How far the dot's centre sits above the arcs' common centre, in icon units (the small Wi-Fi icon's 24-unit grid). The icon's is 2.8; a little higher here so the smaller dot stays close to the inner arc. Higher = closer to the arcs.

settings.label: Inner arc width
settings.description: How wide the inner arc opens, in degrees.

settings.label: Outer arc width
settings.description: How wide the outer arc opens, in degrees.

settings.label: Password field background
settings.description: How visible the grey background of the password field is.

settings.label: Lock icon
settings.description: Shown at the right of networks that need a password.

settings.label: Lock size
settings.description: Size of the lock icon.

settings.label: Password field height
settings.description: Height of the password field that opens under a new secured network.

settings.label: Password field gap
settings.description: Space under the password field.

settings.label: Cancel password icon
settings.description: Icon of the small button at the right of the password field that cancels it.

settings.label: Cancel button inset
settings.description: Space around the cancel button inside the password field.

settings.label: Cancel button icon size
settings.description: Size of the × inside the cancel button.

settings.label: Not connected
settings.description: Grey line under the title when Wi-Fi is on but not connected.

settings.label: Saved networks title
settings.description: Small grey title above the networks you have used before (the one you are on comes first).

settings.label: Other networks title
settings.description: Small grey title above the other networks nearby.

settings.label: Searching
settings.description: Shown while no network has been found yet.

settings.label: Connecting
settings.description: Shown at the right of a network while it connects.

settings.label: Connection failed
settings.description: Shown in red at the right of a network whose last connection failed (often a wrong password).

settings.label: Password placeholder
settings.description: Grey hint in the password field. %1 is the network name.

groups.title: In the launcher
groups.description: How the Wi-Fi panel appears when you search for it.

settings.label: Title
settings.description: Name of the Wi-Fi panel in search results.

settings.label: Description
settings.description: Short text shown on the right of the result.

settings.label: Keywords
settings.description: Extra words (separated by spaces) that also find this panel.

settings.label: Icon
settings.description: Icon file in assets/icons shown next to the result.

sections.title: Bluetooth panel
sections.description: Opens from the launcher, the Bluetooth icon in the idle island, or Bluetooth headphones' icon. Connects your devices and pairs new ones.

groups.title: Layout
groups.description: The Bluetooth panel's own texts (size, motion and the list pill are shared: Panels section).

settings.label: Off text
settings.description: Shown in grey instead of a name while it's off: a hint that the big symbol under it is the switch.

settings.label: List pill text
settings.description: Text of the pill; %1 is the number of devices listed.

groups.title: Bluetooth rune
groups.description: The big rune: the small Bluetooth icon's strokes with its own proportions, scaled up. Blue while a device is connected. Click it to turn Bluetooth on or off.

settings.label: Size
settings.description: How big the rune is: pixels per unit of the small icon's 24-unit grid (4.2 = about 76 px tall).

settings.label: Stroke thickness
settings.description: Thickness of the rune's strokes, in icon units (the small Bluetooth icon's 24-unit grid).

settings.label: Stem half-length
settings.description: Half the length of the rune's vertical stem, in icon units (the small Bluetooth icon's 24-unit grid).

settings.label: Chevron depth
settings.description: How far the rune's two points reach right of the stem, in icon units (the small Bluetooth icon's 24-unit grid).

settings.label: Arm reach
settings.description: How far the rune's two arms reach left of the stem, in icon units (the small Bluetooth icon's 24-unit grid).

groups.title: Device icons
groups.description: Icon for each kind of device, as the device reports it.

settings.label: Headphones
settings.description: Icon shown in front of: headphones, earbuds and headsets.

settings.label: Speaker
settings.description: Icon shown in front of: speakers and other audio devices.

settings.label: Mouse
settings.description: Icon shown in front of: mice, trackpads and drawing tablets.

settings.label: Keyboard
settings.description: Icon shown in front of: keyboards.

settings.label: Game controller
settings.description: Icon shown in front of: game controllers.

settings.label: Phone
settings.description: Icon shown in front of: phones.

settings.label: Computer
settings.description: Icon shown in front of: computers.

settings.label: Other device
settings.description: Icon shown in front of: any device that doesn't say what it is.

settings.label: Click disconnects
settings.description: Clicking a connected device (or pressing Enter on it) disconnects it. Off: connected devices ignore clicks.

settings.label: Give up after
settings.description: How long to wait for a device to pair or connect before showing that it failed (it may be out of range or asleep).

settings.label: No adapter
settings.description: Grey line under the title when the computer has no Bluetooth (or it is blocked).

settings.label: Not connected
settings.description: Grey line under the title when Bluetooth is on but no device is connected.

settings.label: Several connected
settings.description: Grey line under the title when more than one device is connected. %1 is the first device, %2 how many others.

settings.label: My devices title
settings.description: Small grey title above the devices you have paired before (connected ones come first).

settings.label: Other devices title
settings.description: Small grey title above new devices nearby that you can pair with.

settings.label: Searching
settings.description: Shown under "Other devices" while no new device has been found yet.

settings.label: Pairing
settings.description: Shown at the right of a new device while it pairs.

settings.label: Connecting
settings.description: Shown at the right of a device while it connects.

settings.label: Disconnecting
settings.description: Shown at the right of a device while it disconnects.

settings.label: Connection failed
settings.description: Shown in red at the right of a device whose last attempt failed (out of range, asleep, or it asked for a code).

settings.label: Battery level
settings.description: Battery level shown at the right of devices that report it. %1 is the percentage.

groups.title: In the launcher
groups.description: How the Bluetooth panel appears when you search for it.

settings.label: Title
settings.description: Name of the Bluetooth panel in search results.

settings.label: Description
settings.description: Short text shown on the right of the result.

settings.label: Keywords
settings.description: Extra words (separated by spaces) that also find this panel.
settings.default: bluetooth bt devices pair headphones earbuds speaker mouse keyboard controller

settings.label: Icon
settings.description: Icon file in assets/icons shown next to the result.

sections.title: Time panel
sections.description: The panel that opens when you click the clock: analog clock, date and the current week.

groups.title: Layout
groups.description: The time on top, the date, the day as a curved bar, then the week. Width and padding: Panels.

settings.label: Accent color
settings.description: The time panel's color: the day bar and today in the week.

settings.label: Week height
settings.description: Height of the week strip at the bottom.

settings.label: Ticks on the day bar
settings.description: How many ticks the day bar has, from midnight to midnight. 25 = one per hour.

settings.label: Bright tick every
settings.description: Every how many ticks one is brighter. 6 with 25 ticks = midnight, 6, noon, 18, midnight.

groups.title: Time and date
groups.description: Formats use Qt date codes (dddd = weekday, MMMM = month, d = day, yyyy = year, HH = hours, mm = minutes, ss = seconds).

settings.label: Follow the system clock
settings.description: Use the desktop's 12 / 24-hour choice (in the settings app, or GNOME's Date & Time settings) instead of the switch below. Changes show right away.

settings.label: 24-hour clock
settings.description: On: 14:07. Off: 2:07 with AM / PM after the seconds. Used when "Follow the system clock" is off. Applies to the idle clock too.

settings.label: AM / PM format
settings.description: How AM / PM is written on a 12-hour clock (Qt format: AP = AM, ap = am).

settings.label: Seconds format
settings.description: The small grey seconds after the time. Empty = no seconds.

settings.label: Seconds gap
settings.description: Space between the time and its seconds.

settings.label: Date format
settings.description: The line under the time (Qt format: MMMM = month, yyyy = year, dddd = weekday, d = day). Month and year by default: the week row under the bar already shows the weekday and the day.

settings.label: Week number
settings.description: Add the week number after the date.

settings.label: Week number format
settings.description: How the week number is added after the date; %1 is the number.

groups.title: Week
groups.description: The current week at the bottom, like the Calendar widget.

settings.label: First day of the week
settings.description: 0 = Sunday, 1 = Monday, ... 6 = Saturday.

settings.label: Weekend days
settings.description: Days shown in grey (0 = Sunday ... 6 = Saturday).

settings.label: Day label format
settings.description: Format of the day labels; cut to "Letters per day".

settings.label: Letters per day
settings.description: How many letters of each day name to show (1 = M T W...).

settings.label: Day label size
settings.description: Text size of the day labels.

settings.label: Day circle size
settings.description: Size of the circle around each date (filled for today).

settings.label: Date size
settings.description: Text size of the dates.

groups.title: In the launcher
groups.description: How the time panel shows up in search.

settings.label: Title
settings.description: Name in the search results.

settings.label: Subtitle
settings.description: Grey text next to the name.

settings.label: Keywords
settings.description: Other words that find it (space separated).
settings.default: clock date calendar week day hour

settings.label: Icon
settings.description: Icon in the search results.

sections.title: Quick settings
sections.description: Opens when you click the empty middle of the resting island, with Mod+S, or from the launcher: a row of round switches (Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Focus, microphone, power mode) and the brightness and volume bands. Its width: Panels → Layout.

groups.title: Switches
groups.description: The round switches on top: solid in their color when on, soft when off, one grey word under each (the state). Click a switch to turn it on or off; click the word under Wi-Fi or Bluetooth to open its panel.

settings.label: Padding
settings.description: Space between the quick settings panel's edge and its content, all around (its own, not the other panels': more air around a row of small switches).

settings.label: Size
settings.description: Diameter of each round switch.

settings.label: Icon size
settings.description: Size of the icon inside a switch.

settings.label: Word gap
settings.description: Space between a switch and the word under it.

settings.label: Word size
settings.description: Size of the grey word under each switch.

settings.label: Unavailable
settings.description: How visible a switch is when there's nothing to switch (no microphone, no Bluetooth).

groups.title: Words and icons
groups.description: The grey word under each switch says its state; the switch's icon says what it is. Wi-Fi shows the network's name when connected, Bluetooth the device's.

settings.label: Off
settings.description: Under a switch that's off.

settings.label: On
settings.description: Under a switch that's on with nothing more to say (Wi-Fi not connected, Bluetooth with no device, the microphone).

settings.label: Muted
settings.description: Under the microphone while it's muted (its switch is solid red; its icons: Microphone).

settings.label: Missing
settings.description: Under a switch whose device isn't there (no Bluetooth, no microphone).

settings.label: Wi-Fi icon
settings.description: Icon in the Wi-Fi switch.

settings.label: Bluetooth icon
settings.description: Icon in the Bluetooth switch.

settings.label: Focus icon
settings.description: Icon in the Focus switch. On, the island doesn't show notifications (urgent ones: Notifications → Behavior).

settings.label: Focus word
settings.description: The word under the Focus switch (on or off shows in the switch's color).

groups.title: Power mode
groups.description: The last switch shows the current power mode. Click it: it sinks, then morphs into a menu of power saver, balanced and performance, each in its color (Appearance → Colors), opening down and to the left, with the rest of the panel blurred behind it. Pick one, or click anywhere else / press Escape to put it away.

settings.label: Saver word
settings.description: Power saver's name, in the tile and the menu.

settings.label: Saver icon
settings.description: Power saver's icon.

settings.label: Balanced word
settings.description: Balanced's name, in the tile and the menu.

settings.label: Balanced icon
settings.description: Balanced's icon.

settings.label: Performance word
settings.description: Performance's name, in the tile and the menu.

settings.label: Performance icon
settings.description: Performance's icon.

settings.label: Menu width
settings.description: Width of the open menu (it opens from the power badge, down and to the left, kept inside the panel).

settings.label: Menu padding
settings.description: Space between the menu's edge and its rows (the menu's corners stay concentric with the rows').

settings.label: Row height
settings.description: Height of each mode in the menu.

settings.label: Row gap
settings.description: Space between the rows.

settings.label: Row padding
settings.description: Space at the start and end of a row.

settings.label: Row icon size
settings.description: Size of each mode's icon in the menu.

settings.label: Icon gap
settings.description: Space between a row's icon and its word.

settings.label: Text size
settings.description: Size of the words in the menu.

settings.label: Blur behind
settings.description: How blurred the rest of the panel gets while the menu is open (0 = not at all).

settings.label: Blur strength
settings.description: The largest blur radius, for Blur behind at 1.

settings.label: Open / close
settings.description: How the badge morphs into the menu and back. Keep damping at 1 or more: past that the menu wobbles.

settings.label: Press
settings.description: How long the badge takes to sink when pressed (how far: Animation → Small animations → press scale).

settings.label: Hand-off
settings.description: Wait after the press before the menu starts opening. Shorter than the press, so something always moves.

settings.label: Release
settings.description: How long the badge takes to come back up from the press while it opens.

settings.label: Label fade
settings.description: How quickly the badge's icon and word fade as it opens (and the rows as it closes).

settings.label: Label return
settings.description: When closing, the badge's icon and word come back only once the shape is this close to a badge again (0-1).

settings.label: Row slide
settings.description: How long each row takes to fade and slide in.

settings.label: Row travel
settings.description: How far each row slides up as it arrives.

settings.label: Row delay
settings.description: Wait after the menu starts opening before the first row arrives.

settings.label: Row stagger
settings.description: How much later each row arrives than the one above it.

groups.title: Keyboard
groups.description: Quick settings works fully without the mouse. Opened from the keyboard, the first switch is selected right away. Arrows or Tab move a grey highlight between the switches and the brightness / volume rows, Space toggles (or mutes), Enter also opens Wi-Fi / Bluetooth and the power menu, Left / Right change a level, Escape closes.

settings.label: Keyboard highlight padding
settings.description: How far the keyboard's grey highlight reaches above and below a switch's tile, and around a brightness / volume row (its look and spring are the Wi-Fi and Bluetooth lists': Panels → list).

settings.label: Keyboard highlight width
settings.description: How far the keyboard's highlight on a switch reaches past the switch's own share of the row, on each side (it may overlap its neighbours a little: only one shows at a time).

settings.label: Keyboard highlight below
settings.description: Extra room the keyboard's highlight on a switch gets under the switch's word.

groups.title: Brightness and volume
groups.description: The two meters under the switches: a row of bars, dim, bright up to the level (red past 100 % volume). Drag, click or scroll; click the speaker to mute. Brightness only shows on a screen with a backlight; their icons: Brightness, Volume.

settings.label: Gap above
settings.description: Space between the switches' words and the first meter.

settings.label: Gap between
settings.description: Space between the two meters.

settings.label: Icon size
settings.description: Size of the sun and the speaker, at the left of the meters.

settings.label: Gap
settings.description: Space between the icon, the meter and the value.

settings.label: Value size
settings.description: Size of the grey percentage at the right.

groups.title: In the launcher
groups.description: How quick settings appear when you search for them.

settings.label: Title
settings.description: Name of quick settings in search results.

settings.label: Description
settings.description: Short text shown on the right of the result.

settings.label: Keywords
settings.description: Extra words (separated by spaces) that also find this panel.
settings.default: control center toggles focus do not disturb dnd microphone mic volume brightness power mode

settings.label: Icon
settings.description: Icon file in assets/icons shown next to the result.

settings.label: Quick settings transition overrides
settings.description: Transition settings that apply only to quick settings. Same keys as Animation > Content transition.

sections.title: Media panel
sections.description: The panel that shows what's playing (opened from the little music bars in the idle island, the launcher or `qs ipc call island toggle media`): cover, title, artist, progress and controls, like the iPhone's Dynamic Island.

groups.title: Layout
groups.description: The cover, the title and the artist on top, the progress bar, then the controls. Width: Panels.

settings.label: Padding
settings.description: Space between the media panel's edge and what's inside (its own: a bit more than the other panels).

settings.label: Cover size
settings.description: Size of the album cover at the top left.

settings.label: No cover icon
settings.description: Icon shown on a soft tile when the track has no cover.

settings.label: No cover icon size
settings.description: Size of that icon.

settings.label: Space beside the text
settings.description: Space between the cover, the title and the bars.

settings.label: Space between the lines
settings.description: Space between the title and the artist.

settings.label: Title size
settings.description: Text size of the track's title.

settings.label: Title weight
settings.description: Thickness of the title (400 = regular, 600 = semibold).

settings.label: Artist size
settings.description: Text size of the artist, in grey under the title.

settings.label: Nothing playing
settings.description: Shown in grey instead of the title when no app is playing anything.

groups.title: Progress
groups.description: The bar with the time played at the left and the time left at the right. Drag or scroll it to move in the track.

settings.label: Space above
settings.description: Space between the cover and the progress bar.

settings.label: Space beside the times
settings.description: Space between each time and the bar.

settings.label: Time size
settings.description: Text size of the two times.

settings.label: Scroll step
settings.description: How far one notch of the mouse wheel moves in the track.

settings.label: Scroll seek delay
settings.description: When scrolling on the bar, how long it waits after the last notch before moving the music (dragging moves it when you let go).

settings.label: Progress step
settings.description: How far the progress bar's fill moves at a time, in screen pixels. Smaller = smoother, at the cost of a few more redraws (0.5: about two a second on a 3-minute song).

settings.label: Fastest update
settings.description: The progress bar moves a small step at a time (Progress step), read from the player's position; on a very short track, at most this often.

settings.label: Fade in
settings.description: When the player starts or stops giving the track's length while the panel is open: how long the progress bar takes to fade in once the island has grown for it (or to fade out before it shrinks).

settings.label: Scale in from
settings.description: Size the progress bar starts at as it fades in.

groups.title: Controls
groups.description: Previous, play / pause and next, centred at the bottom.

settings.label: Space above
settings.description: Space between the progress bar and the controls.

settings.label: Previous / next size
settings.description: Size of the previous and next buttons.

settings.label: Play size
settings.description: Size of the play / pause button (a bit bigger, in the middle).

settings.label: Spacing
settings.description: Distance from the middle of play / pause to the middle of previous and next.

settings.label: Unavailable
settings.description: How visible a button is when the player can't do it (e.g. no next track).

settings.label: Play / pause swap size
settings.description: How small the glyph that goes away gets while play and pause swap.

settings.label: Play / pause swap
settings.description: How long play and pause take to swap.

settings.label: Skip push
settings.description: How long the previous / next button's little push takes when you skip: a new triangle grows in at the back while the front one is pushed out.

settings.label: Skip triangles gap
settings.description: How far apart the two triangles of the previous / next buttons are, as a share of the button's size.

settings.label: Play icon
settings.description: Icon of the play button.

settings.label: Pause icon
settings.description: Icon of the pause button.

settings.label: Skip icon
settings.description: One triangle of the previous / next buttons: drawn twice side by side (mirrored for previous), so skipping can push a new one in.

groups.title: Fullscreen
groups.description: Double-click an empty spot of the media panel: the island grows to fill the screen, the cover flies to a big picture in the middle (its own proportions) with the title and artist growing under it, over a very blurry copy of the picture (black without one), and the progress bar and the controls go to the bottom, bigger. The badge at the top right, Escape or another double-click go back.

settings.label: Double-click for fullscreen
settings.description: Double-clicking an empty spot of the media panel fills the screen with it.

settings.label: Controls size
settings.description: How much bigger previous, play / pause and next get in fullscreen.

settings.label: Progress bar size
settings.description: How much bigger the progress bar and its times get in fullscreen (it also stretches across the screen).

settings.label: Space at the sides
settings.description: Space between the screen's sides and the ends of the progress row in fullscreen.

settings.label: Space below
settings.description: Space between the bottom of the screen and the controls in fullscreen.

settings.label: Space above the controls
settings.description: Space between the progress bar and the controls in fullscreen.

settings.label: Background
settings.description: Color behind everything in fullscreen when there's no cover or thumbnail; also darkens the blurry background and the shade at the bottom.

settings.label: Picture height
settings.description: Height of the cover or video thumbnail in fullscreen, as a share of the screen's height (0.5 = half). It keeps its own proportions, and is never wider than the progress bar.

settings.label: Picture reshape
settings.description: Spring used when the next track's picture has other proportions (a video thumbnail after an album cover): the picture smoothly changes shape. Lower damping bounces more.

settings.label: Picture shadow
settings.description: How dark the soft shadow under the picture is in fullscreen. 0 = no shadow.

settings.label: Shadow softness
settings.description: How far the picture's shadow spreads out and fades (bigger = softer, wider).

settings.label: Shadow drop
settings.description: How far below the picture its shadow falls, as if lit from above.

settings.label: Shadow size
settings.description: How much bigger than the picture the shadow is before it fades.

settings.label: Picture position
settings.description: Where the picture, the title and the artist sit in fullscreen: in the middle, or at the left (lined up with the progress bar's left end). Either way they're centred, together, in the space above the progress bar.

settings.label: Title size
settings.description: How much bigger the track's title gets in fullscreen, where it sits under the picture.

settings.label: Artist size
settings.description: How much bigger the artist gets in fullscreen, under the title.

settings.label: Space between the lines
settings.description: Space between the title and the artist in fullscreen.

settings.label: Space above the title
settings.description: Space between the picture and the title in fullscreen.

settings.label: Space below the artist
settings.description: Smallest space between the artist and the progress bar in fullscreen (the picture and the text are centred in the space above it).

settings.label: Text stays under the picture
settings.description: The title and artist follow the picture's bottom edge. On the way back from fullscreen they stay under it until this share of the way is left (0.3 = the last 30 %), then slide up beside the small cover, keeping to the right of the picture; going fullscreen, the reverse.

settings.label: Background blur
settings.description: How blurry the copy of the picture behind everything is.

settings.label: Background darkening
settings.description: How much the blurry background is darkened, so the picture and the controls stand out.

settings.label: Background detail
settings.description: The background picture is shrunk to about this size before being blurred: smaller is blurrier and lighter for the computer.

settings.label: Background overscan
settings.description: The blurry background is drawn this much bigger than the screen, so its soft, see-through edges stay out of sight.

settings.label: Bottom shade height
settings.description: Height of the dark band at the bottom of the screen that keeps the controls readable over a bright picture.

settings.label: Bottom shade strength
settings.description: How dark that band gets at the very bottom.

settings.label: Picture fade in
settings.description: How long the blurry background takes to fade in once the picture is loaded.

settings.label: Top row fade
settings.description: The title and bars at the top fade away during the first part of the growth, this share of it (0.3 = the first 30 %), while the blurry background comes in; on the way back, the reverse over the last part. The exit button fades in during the same share at the end.

settings.label: Exit icon
settings.description: Icon of the button at the top right that leaves fullscreen.

settings.label: Exit button size
settings.description: Size of the round button that leaves fullscreen.

settings.label: Exit icon size
settings.description: Size of the icon in that button.

settings.label: Exit button spacing
settings.description: Space between the exit button and the top and right edges of the screen.

groups.title: Music bars
groups.description: The little bars at the top right that move with the music, in the cover's color (also in the idle island). They follow the real sound when the small program cava is installed (sudo dnf install cava); without it they dance on their own.

settings.label: Follow the music
settings.description: Make the bars follow what's actually playing (bass at the left, treble at the right). Needs cava installed; it runs only while music plays and the bars are on screen. Off: the bars dance on their own.

settings.label: Updates per second
settings.description: How many times a second the bars follow the sound (more = smoother, a bit more work for the computer).

settings.label: Smoothing
settings.description: How calm the bars are when following the music (higher = softer, slower moves; lower = twitchier).

settings.label: Glide
settings.description: Following the music, how long each bar takes to move to a new height. Longer = calmer, rounder moves; shorter = snappier.

settings.label: Keep listening
settings.description: Following the music: how long the listening keeps going after the last bars leave the screen, so it isn't restarted when the music alert hands over to the idle island.

settings.label: Lowest pitch
settings.description: The deepest sound the leftmost bar listens to.

settings.label: Highest pitch
settings.description: The highest sound the rightmost bar listens to.

settings.label: Bars
settings.description: How many bars.

settings.label: Bar width
settings.description: Width of each bar (round ends).

settings.label: Gap
settings.description: Space between the bars.

settings.label: Height
settings.description: Height of the bars at their tallest.

settings.label: Beat
settings.description: Without cava: how often the bars pick a new height (lower = busier).

settings.label: Lowest
settings.description: Without cava: how low a bar can go while playing (share of its full height).

settings.label: Paused height
settings.description: Height of the bars while paused or silent (share of the full height); following the music, they never go below it.

settings.label: Corner space
settings.description: In the media panel: extra space between the bars and the panel's top and right edges, on top of the padding.

groups.title: Cover color
groups.description: The bars take their color from the cover, like on the iPhone.

settings.label: Without a cover
settings.description: Color of the bars when the cover can't be read (no cover, or one on the internet: only covers saved on the computer are read).

settings.label: Least brightness
settings.description: The cover's color is made at least this bright, so it shows on black.

settings.label: Saturation boost
settings.description: Multiplies the cover color's saturation (1 = as is).

settings.label: Prefer colorful
settings.description: How much a colorful part of the cover is preferred over a bright grey one.

settings.label: Colors looked at
settings.description: The cover is boiled down to 2 to the power of this many colors before one is picked.

settings.label: Sample size
settings.description: The cover is shrunk to this size before its colors are read (smaller = faster).

groups.title: In the launcher
groups.description: How the media panel appears when you search for it.

settings.label: Title
settings.description: Name in the search results.

settings.label: Subtitle
settings.description: Grey text next to the name.

settings.label: Keywords
settings.description: Other words that find it (space separated).
settings.default: media music song play pause next previous track player spotify

settings.label: Icon
settings.description: Icon in the search results.

sections.title: Wallpaper panel
sections.description: Your wallpapers as a row of cards: arrows pick one, Enter puts it on the desktop.

groups.title: Pictures
groups.description: Where the wallpapers come from. Applied the same way as the Settings app, so both always agree.

settings.label: Folders
settings.description: The folders whose pictures are shown (and their subfolders). ~ is your home folder; * matches anything, so ~/Pictures/[Ww]allpaper* finds Wallpaper, wallpapers...

settings.label: File types
settings.description: Which files count as pictures, by extension.

settings.label: Subfolder depth
settings.description: How far into subfolders pictures are looked for. 1 = only the folders themselves, 3 = two levels of subfolders (the same as the Settings app).

settings.label: Close after applying
settings.description: On: Enter puts the wallpaper on and closes the panel. Off: the panel stays open so you can try another.

settings.label: Empty folder text
settings.description: Shown instead of the cards when the folders have no pictures.
settings.default: No pictures in your Wallpaper folder

settings.label: Tidy names
settings.description: Show file names as words: "inner-light.jpg" reads "Inner light".

groups.title: In the launcher
groups.description: How the wallpaper panel shows up in search.

settings.label: Title
settings.description: Name in the search results.

settings.label: Subtitle
settings.description: Grey text next to the name.

settings.label: Keywords
settings.description: Other words that find it (space separated).

settings.label: Icon
settings.description: Icon in the search results.

sections.title: Picture carousels
sections.description: The row of cards in the wallpaper and screenshots panels: the picked one in front, its neighbours turned behind it. Both panels have the launcher's width and padding (Search); the front card fills what the side cards leave. Corners follow the corner style (tiles).

settings.label: Card shape
settings.description: Width divided by height of every card. 0 = the same shape as your screen.

settings.label: Cards on each side
settings.description: How many pictures show behind the front one, on each side.

settings.label: Side card distance
settings.description: How far each card behind sits from the one before it. The panel is as wide as the launcher, so a bigger distance makes the front card smaller.

settings.label: Side card size
settings.description: Size of the cards behind, compared to the front one (each further card shrinks again).

settings.label: Side card turn
settings.description: How much the cards behind are turned, left ones one way, right ones the other.

settings.label: Side card darkening
settings.description: How much darker the cards behind are. 0 = as bright as the front one.

settings.label: Name position
settings.description: Where the picture's name sits: above the cards (like the Wi-Fi and Bluetooth panels' names) or under them.

settings.label: Name gap
settings.description: Space between the cards and the picture's name.

settings.label: Slide spring
settings.description: How the row slides to the next picture.

settings.label: End bump
settings.description: How far the row slides when you push past the first or last picture, in cards.

settings.label: End bump push
settings.description: How long the push past the end takes, before it springs back.

settings.label: End bump spring
settings.description: How the row springs back after a push past the end.

settings.label: Drag momentum
settings.description: How far a quick drag carries on after you let go (seconds of its speed). 0 = it stops where you let go.

settings.label: Drag past the ends
settings.description: How far you can drag past the first or last picture, in cards.

settings.label: Press
settings.description: How much the front card sinks when you use it (put a wallpaper on, copy a screenshot).

settings.label: Apply press time
settings.description: How long the card takes to sink before it springs back.

settings.label: Apply spring
settings.description: How the card springs back after sinking.

groups.title: Standing out
groups.description: What sets the cards apart from the island, so a dark picture doesn't melt into it (no outline).

settings.label: Style
settings.description: glow: each picture's own colours, blurred, spread softly around its card (strongest on the front one). lift: a faint light under every card. none: nothing.

settings.label: Glow strength
settings.description: How visible the glow around the front card is.

settings.label: Glow behind
settings.description: How strong the glow of the cards behind the front one is, as a share of the front card's (0 = only the front card glows).

settings.label: Glow softness
settings.description: How far the picture is blurred for its glow.

settings.label: Glow size
settings.description: How far past the card the glow reaches.
