settings.label: Glow brightness
settings.description: Brightens the glow, so even a dark picture lights up its surroundings a little.

settings.label: Glow colour
settings.description: How colourful the glow is (0 = the picture's colours, more = richer).

settings.label: Lift strength
settings.description: How bright the light under each card is.

settings.label: Lift softness
settings.description: How soft the light's edge is.

settings.label: Lift size
settings.description: How far the light reaches past the card before it fades.

groups.title: Check badge
groups.description: The check on the wallpaper in use, or on the screenshot you just copied.

settings.label: Icon
settings.description: Glyph on the marked picture: the wallpaper in use, the screenshot you just copied.

settings.label: Badge size
settings.description: Size of the round badge.

settings.label: Glyph size
settings.description: Size of the check inside the badge.

settings.label: Badge inset
settings.description: Distance from the card's top right corner.

settings.label: Pop-in size
settings.description: Size the badge grows from when a wallpaper is put on.

settings.label: Pop-in spring
settings.description: How the badge pops in.

settings.label: Picture under the pointer
settings.description: Width of the small copy of the picture that follows the pointer while you drag a screenshot out of the island.

settings.label: Start delay
settings.description: Time between picking a picture up and the drag starting, so the invisible layer that closes panels on a click outside is gone first (otherwise it would catch the drop).

sections.title: Screenshots panel
sections.description: Your recent screenshots as a row of cards: click or Enter copies one, drag it out of the island to drop it on a website, a chat or a folder.

groups.title: Behavior
groups.description: The pictures come from the screenshot folder (Screenshot pop-up > Folder).

settings.label: File types
settings.description: Which kinds of pictures in the screenshot folder are listed.

settings.label: Close after copying
settings.description: Copying a screenshot also closes the panel, so you can paste it right away.

settings.label: Close after showing in Files
settings.description: Shift+Enter (or a right click on the front screenshot) shows it in the Files app, selected; this also closes the panel.

settings.label: Drag out of the island
settings.description: Drag the front screenshot up or down out of the island and drop it anywhere that takes a file: a mail you're writing, a website's upload area, a chat, a folder. Apps in a sandbox (like a browser installed as a Flatpak) receive the file itself.

settings.label: Nothing yet
settings.description: Shown when the screenshot folder has no pictures.

settings.label: Copy command
settings.description: Command that copies a picture to the clipboard as an image: {path} is replaced by its file.

groups.title: Cards
groups.description: Each card takes its screenshot's shape, within these limits; a picture past them is cropped around its centre to fill a card of the limit's shape.

settings.label: Narrowest card
settings.description: How narrow a card can get, as width ÷ height (0.75 = a bit taller than wide). A tall, thin screenshot gets a card this shape.

settings.label: Widest card
settings.description: How wide a card can get, as width ÷ height (1.78 = a 16:9 screen). A long, flat screenshot gets a card this shape. The widest card sets the cards' height.

groups.title: Copied tag
groups.description: What the screenshot you just copied wears.

settings.label: Icon
settings.description: Glyph on the screenshot you just copied.

settings.label: Word
settings.description: Word next to the glyph (empty = the glyph alone).

groups.title: When it was taken
groups.description: The line above the cards: "Today at 19:52".

settings.label: Line
settings.description: {day} is replaced by the day, {time} by the time.

settings.label: Today
settings.description: The day's name for today's screenshots.

settings.label: Yesterday
settings.description: The day's name for yesterday's screenshots.

settings.label: Older days
settings.description: How older days are written (Qt date format: dddd = weekday, d = day, MMMM = month).

settings.label: Time (24-hour)
settings.description: How the time is written with the 24-hour clock.

settings.label: Time (12-hour)
settings.description: How the time is written with the 12-hour clock.

groups.title: In the launcher
groups.description: How the screenshots panel shows up in search.

settings.label: Title
settings.description: Name in the search results.

settings.label: Subtitle
settings.description: Grey line under the name.
settings.default: Copy or drag a recent screenshot

settings.label: Keywords
settings.description: Other words that find it (space separated).
settings.default: screenshot screen capture copy clipboard picture

settings.label: Icon
settings.description: Icon in the search results.

sections.title: Search
sections.description: Spotlight-style search for island panels, actions, apps and calculations, opened with `qs ipc call island toggle search`.

settings.label: Width
settings.description: Width of the search panel.

settings.label: Padding
settings.description: Space between the panel edge and its content.

settings.label: Field to results gap
settings.description: Space between the search field and the results.

settings.label: Field height
settings.description: Height of the search field.

settings.label: Field text size
settings.description: Text size of what you type.

settings.label: Placeholder
settings.description: Hint shown in the empty search field (type a prefix like f: to search files).

settings.label: Search icon
settings.description: Magnifier shown in front of the search field.

settings.label: Search icon size
settings.description: Size of the magnifier in front of the search field.

settings.label: Search icon gap
settings.description: Space between the magnifier and the text.

settings.label: Divider thickness
settings.description: Thickness of the thin line between the search field and the results.

settings.label: Divider visibility
settings.description: How visible the line between the search field and the results is.

settings.label: Number of results
settings.description: Most results listed for a search. Past "Visible rows before scrolling" the list scrolls.

settings.label: Visible rows before scrolling
settings.description: The results grow up to this many rows, then the list scrolls (mouse wheel, drag, or the arrow keys).

settings.label: Scroll edge fade
settings.description: Height of the fade at the top or bottom of the results when there are more to scroll to. 0 = no fade.

settings.label: Keyboard scroll speed
settings.description: How long the results take to scroll to the one picked with the arrow keys.

settings.label: Result height
settings.description: Height of each result row.

settings.label: Result padding
settings.description: Space around the name and description in a result.

settings.label: Result icon size
settings.description: Size of app icons in the results.

settings.label: Icon inset
settings.description: Space between the left edge of a result and its icon.

settings.label: Description size
settings.description: Text size of the app description on the right of a result.

settings.label: Text selection opacity
settings.description: Opacity of the highlight behind selected text in the field.

settings.label: Calculator symbol size
settings.description: Size of the "=" shown next to a calculation result, compared to the app icon size.

settings.label: Description width
settings.description: Widest the right-hand label (kind, "Open ↵") may get, as a share of the row width.

settings.label: Panel icon size
settings.description: Size of island panel icons in the results, compared to app icons.

settings.label: Section title height
settings.description: Height of the small grey titles above each group of results (Applications, Commands...).

settings.label: Name to subtitle gap
settings.description: Space between a result name and the grey text after it.

settings.label: Key height
settings.description: Height of the little key shown on the selected result ("↵").

settings.label: Key padding
settings.description: Space on each side of the key symbol.

settings.label: Key gap
settings.description: Space between "Open" and the key.

settings.label: Key background
settings.description: How visible the background of the little key is.

settings.label: Enter key symbol
settings.description: What the little key on the selected result shows.

groups.title: Pinned
groups.description: Pin panels, apps and commands (Ctrl+P or a right-click on a result): with nothing typed, the launcher shows them as tiles. Arrows move, Enter opens, Ctrl+Left / Right or dragging reorders, Ctrl+P or a right-click unpins.

settings.label: Tiles per row
settings.description: How many pinned tiles fit in a row of the launcher (shown when nothing is typed).

settings.label: Tile height
settings.description: Height of a pinned tile (its icon and name).

settings.label: Tile row gap
settings.description: Space between two rows of pinned tiles.

settings.label: Tile icon size
settings.description: Size of a pinned tile's icon.

settings.label: Tile padding
settings.description: Space above a tile's icon and on each side of its name.

settings.label: Tile name gap
settings.description: Space between a tile's icon and its name.

settings.label: Tile name size
settings.description: Text size of a tile's name.

settings.label: Drag start
settings.description: How far you press and move a pinned tile before it starts being dragged (less = a click).

settings.label: Dragged tile size
settings.description: A dragged tile grows a little to show it's lifted.

settings.label: Pin key
settings.description: With Ctrl, pins or unpins the selected result or tile (a right-click does too).

settings.label: Pinned mark
settings.description: Small icon shown on a result that's pinned.

settings.label: Pinned mark size
settings.description: Size of that small icon.

groups.title: Actions
groups.description: Commands you can run from the search, like opening the trash or powering off.

settings.label: Actions
settings.description: Each action has a title, a description, extra keywords, an icon and the command it runs. Actions marked "confirm" need Enter pressed twice, so a stray Enter can't reboot or power off.

default.title: Power Off
default.subtitle: Shut down the computer
default.keywords: shutdown shut down poweroff turn off

settings.label: Confirmation text
settings.description: Shown next to an action that is waiting for its second Enter.

settings.label: Shrink delay while typing
settings.description: How long typing must pause before the panel shrinks to fewer results. Growing is instant.

groups.title: Calculator
groups.description: Calculations typed in the search (12*4, 2^10): Enter copies the result.

settings.label: Show
settings.description: When calculations show up. always = a calculation comes first whenever what you type is one, and typing a prefix ("=") shows only it. prefix = only after typing a prefix. off = never.

settings.label: Prefixes
settings.description: What you type at the start of the search to show only the calculation (it turns into a pill), e.g. "=", "calc:".

settings.label: Pill label
settings.description: Name in the pill while calculating.

settings.label: Placeholder
settings.description: Hint shown in the search field while calculating.

settings.label: Pill icon
settings.description: Icon in the pill while calculating (file name in assets/icons).

groups.title: Settings search
groups.description: The desktop's settings (Wi-Fi, displays, the mouse...) found by name; Enter opens the Settings app on that page.

settings.label: Show
settings.description: When settings show up. always = among the other results, and typing a prefix ("s:") shows only settings. prefix = only after typing a prefix. off = never.

settings.label: Settings among other results
settings.description: How many settings show among the other results when settings are shown always. Typing a prefix shows them all.

settings.label: Prefixes
settings.description: What you type at the start of the search to search only settings (it turns into a pill), e.g. "s:", "settings:".

settings.label: Pill label
settings.description: Name in the pill while searching only settings.

settings.label: Placeholder
settings.description: Hint shown in the search field while searching only settings.

settings.label: Pill icon
settings.description: Icon in the pill while searching only settings (file name in assets/icons).

settings.label: Page icons
settings.description: Show each setting with its page's icon from the Settings app (a mouse for Mouse & Touchpad, a speaker for Sound). Off: the same gear for every setting.

settings.label: Result icon
settings.description: Icon of a setting in the results when it has no page icon (or page icons are off); file name in assets/icons.

settings.label: List command
settings.description: Command that prints every setting as JSON ([{page, pageLabel, title}]); run each time the search opens. Without it (the Settings app isn't installed), no settings show.

settings.label: Open command
settings.description: Command that opens the Settings app on a setting: {page} is replaced by its page's name, {title} by the setting's (Settings scrolls to it and highlights it).

groups.title: Web search
groups.description: What you type can also be searched on the web: the last result opens your browser on it. A web address (like rust-lang.org) opens that site instead.

settings.label: Show
settings.description: When the web search shows up. always = it's always the last result (Enter picks it when nothing else matches), and typing one of its prefixes shows only it. prefix = only after typing one of its prefixes ("w:", it turns into a pill). off = never.

settings.label: Prefixes
settings.description: What you type at the start of the search to search only the web (it turns into a pill), e.g. "w:", "web:".

settings.label: Pill label
settings.description: Name in the pill while searching only the web.

settings.label: Placeholder
settings.description: Hint shown in the search field while searching only the web.

settings.label: Pill icon
settings.description: Icon in the pill while searching only the web (file name in assets/icons).

settings.label: Search engine name
settings.description: Name shown in grey next to the web search result.

settings.label: Search address
settings.description: The search engine's address. {query} is replaced by what you typed. For DuckDuckGo: https://duckduckgo.com/?q={query}

settings.label: Open web addresses
settings.description: When what you typed looks like a web address (rust-lang.org, https://...), the last result opens that site instead of searching for it.

settings.label: Web icon
settings.description: Icon shown next to the web result (file name in assets/icons).

settings.label: Open command
settings.description: How the web page is opened. The default opens it in your usual browser. {url} is replaced by the address.

groups.title: File search
groups.description: Type a prefix such as "f:" to search your files and folders instead of apps. Enter opens the result, Shift+Enter shows it in the file manager.

settings.label: Show
settings.description: When files and folders show up. prefix = only after typing one of the prefixes ("f:", it turns into a pill), so the usual results stay short. always = the best matches among the other results too (search.files.mixedResults of them), and a prefix shows only files. off = never.

settings.label: Files among other results
settings.description: How many files and folders show among the other results when files are shown always. Typing a prefix shows them all.

settings.label: Prefixes
settings.description: What you type at the start of the search to search only files and folders (it turns into a pill). Add, remove or rename them freely, e.g. "f:", "file:", "files:".

settings.label: Pill label
settings.description: Text shown in the pill while searching files.

settings.label: Pill icon
settings.description: Icon in the pill while searching files (file name in assets/icons).

settings.label: Placeholder
settings.description: Hint shown in the search field while searching files.

settings.label: Search folder
settings.description: Folder whose contents are searched (including sub-folders). ~ is your home folder.

settings.label: Show hidden files
settings.description: Also search hidden files and folders (names starting with a dot, like .config).

settings.label: Skipped folders
settings.description: Folders with these names are never searched or shown, anywhere: dependency, build and cache folders (node_modules, target, __pycache__, .venv...). Patterns like *.log work too.

settings.label: Maximum files
settings.description: Safety limit on how many files and folders are kept for searching. Only matters for very large folders.

settings.label: Folder icon
settings.description: Icon shown next to folders (file name in assets/icons).

settings.label: Image icon
settings.description: Icon shown next to images (file name in assets/icons).

settings.label: File icon
settings.description: Icon shown next to every other file (file name in assets/icons).

settings.label: Image file types
settings.description: File extensions that count as images (they get the image icon).

settings.label: Open command
settings.description: How a file or folder is opened. The default opens it in its usual app (folders in the file manager).

settings.label: Show in folder command
settings.description: How Shift+Enter shows a file in the file manager. The default asks your file manager to open the folder with the file selected.

groups.title: Search pill
groups.description: The pill that replaces a prefix like "f:" in the search field. Backspace on an empty field removes it.

settings.label: Height
settings.description: Height of the pill.

settings.label: Inner padding
settings.description: Space between the pill's edges and its icon / text.

settings.label: Icon to text gap
settings.description: Space between the pill's icon and its label.

settings.label: Gap to text
settings.description: Space between the pill and what you type.

settings.label: Icon size
settings.description: Size of the icon in the pill.

settings.label: Text size
settings.description: Size of the pill's label.

settings.label: Background strength
settings.description: How visible the pill's background is.

settings.label: Fade
settings.description: How long the pill takes to fade in or out.

settings.label: Make-room spring
settings.description: How the search text slides aside to make room for the pill (and back when it's removed).

settings.label: Pop start size
settings.description: Size the pill starts from when it appears, before springing to full size. Lower = bigger pop.

settings.label: Pop spring
settings.description: Bounce of the pill as it appears. Lower damping = more bounce.

groups.title: Labels
groups.description: Section titles, the grey kind at the right of each result, and what Enter does on the selected one.

settings.label: Calculator section
settings.description: Title above a calculation result.

settings.label: Island panels section
settings.description: Title above island panels (Battery, Wi-Fi...).

settings.label: Commands section
settings.description: Title above commands (Trash, Reboot...).

settings.label: Applications section
settings.description: Title above applications.

settings.label: Files section
settings.description: Title above files and folders.

settings.label: Web search section
settings.description: Title above the web search result.

settings.label: Web address section
settings.description: Title above the result that opens a typed web address.

settings.label: Settings group title
settings.description: Title above the settings in the results.

settings.label: Calculation label
settings.description: Grey label at the right of a calculation.

settings.label: Panel label
settings.description: Grey label at the right of an island panel.

settings.label: Command label
settings.description: Grey label at the right of a command.

settings.label: Application label
settings.description: Grey label at the right of an application.

settings.label: File label
settings.description: Grey label at the right of a file.

settings.label: Folder label
settings.description: Grey label at the right of a folder.

settings.label: Web search label
settings.description: Grey label at the right of the web search result.

settings.label: Web address label
settings.description: Grey label at the right of a typed web address.

settings.label: Setting
settings.description: Word at the right of a setting in the results.

settings.label: Calculation action
settings.description: Shown on a selected calculation: what Enter does.

settings.label: Panel action
settings.description: Shown on a selected island panel: what Enter does.

settings.label: Command action
settings.description: Shown on a selected command: what Enter does.

settings.label: Application action
settings.description: Shown on a selected application: what Enter does.

settings.label: File action
settings.description: Shown on a selected file: what Enter does (Shift+Enter shows it in the file manager).

settings.label: Folder action
settings.description: Shown on a selected folder: what Enter does.

settings.label: Web search action
settings.description: Shown on the selected web search result: what Enter does.

settings.label: Web address action
settings.description: Shown on a selected web address: what Enter does.

settings.label: Setting
settings.description: What Enter does on a setting, shown on the selected row.

sections.title: Level bar
sections.description: The bar shown for volume and brightness.

settings.label: Bar thickness
settings.description: Thickness of the volume and brightness bars.

settings.label: Empty part
settings.description: How visible the empty part of the bar is.

settings.label: Muted look
settings.description: How faded the bar and number look while the sound is muted.

settings.label: Grab area
settings.description: Extra space above and below the bar that still lets you grab it.

settings.label: Level movement
settings.description: How the bar moves to a new level.

settings.label: Bump size
settings.description: How much longer the bar gets, for a moment, when you push past 0 % or the maximum.

settings.label: Stretch speed
settings.description: How fast the bar grows before springing back.

settings.label: Spring back
settings.description: How the bar springs back to its size after a bump.

sections.title: Volume
sections.description: The volume island (volume keys).

settings.label: Width
settings.description: Width of the volume island.

settings.label: Icon size
settings.description: Size of the speaker icon.

settings.label: Speaker icons
settings.description: Speaker icons for 0 %, low and high volume. The high one is shown dimmed behind, with the one for the current level bright on top, so all three must be drawn at the same place in their files.

settings.label: Muted icon
settings.description: Speaker icon while the sound is muted.

settings.label: Low volume up to
settings.description: Below this volume (1 = 100 %) the low-volume speaker icon shows.

settings.label: Show percentage
settings.description: Show the volume as a number next to the bar.

settings.label: Number size
settings.description: Text size of the volume number.

settings.label: Show volume changes
settings.description: Show the volume in the island when you press the volume keys. Off: the keys still change the volume, the island stays as it is.

settings.label: Step
settings.description: How much one key press or scroll notch changes the volume (0.05 = 5 %).

settings.label: Maximum volume
settings.description: Highest volume the keys and bar allow (1 = 100 %). Above 100 % shows in red.

settings.label: Unmute when changed
settings.description: Changing the volume turns the sound back on if it was muted.

settings.label: Stays for
settings.description: How long the volume island stays after the last change.

sections.title: Brightness
sections.description: The brightness island (brightness keys).

settings.label: Width
settings.description: Width of the brightness island (the same as the volume one by default, so the two pop-ups match).

settings.label: Icon size
settings.description: Size of the sun icon.

settings.label: Sun icons
settings.description: Sun icons from dim to bright; the level is split evenly between them.

settings.label: Sun turn
settings.description: How far the sun turns between 0 % and 100 %.

settings.label: Show percentage
settings.description: Show the brightness percentage at the right of the bar.

settings.label: Number size
settings.description: Size of the brightness percentage.

settings.label: Show brightness changes
settings.description: Show the brightness in the island when you press the brightness keys. Off: the keys still change the brightness, the island stays as it is.

settings.label: Step
settings.description: How much one key press or scroll notch changes the brightness (0.05 = 5 %).

settings.label: Lowest brightness
settings.description: The keys and bar never go darker than this, so the screen never turns fully black (0.01 = 1 %).

settings.label: Stays for
settings.description: How long the brightness island stays after the last change.

settings.label: Backlight device
settings.description: Name of the screen backlight in /sys/class/backlight. Empty = the first one found.

sections.title: Microphone
sections.description: The island shown when the microphone is muted or turned back on.

settings.label: Show microphone mute
settings.description: Show the microphone state in the island when you press the mute key. Off: the key still mutes, the island stays as it is.

settings.label: Live icon
settings.description: Microphone icon while it's on.

settings.label: Muted icon
settings.description: Microphone icon while it's muted.

settings.label: Live text
settings.description: Text shown when the microphone is turned on.

settings.label: Muted text
settings.description: Text shown when the microphone is muted.

settings.label: Shake
settings.description: How far the badge tilts when it shakes on mute.

settings.label: Shake length
settings.description: How long the mute shake lasts.

settings.label: Stays for
settings.description: How long the microphone island stays.

settings.label: Width
settings.description: Width of the microphone pop-up. The capsule sits at the left end and the state at the right end.

settings.label: Capsule width
settings.description: Width of the capsule holding the microphone at the left end.

sections.title: Messages
sections.description: Short messages sent by scripts (qs ipc call osd message "text" "icon.svg").

settings.label: Show messages
settings.description: Show messages that scripts send to the island (qs ipc call osd message).

settings.label: Maximum width
settings.description: Longer messages are cut with an ellipsis.

settings.label: Default icon
settings.description: Icon used when the message doesn't name one.

settings.label: Stays for
settings.description: How long a message stays.

sections.title: Low battery alert
sections.description: The warning shown in the island when the battery runs low.

settings.label: Show the alert
settings.description: Warn in the island when the battery runs low.

settings.label: Warn at
settings.description: Battery levels that trigger the warning, once each while on battery (e.g. 15 % then again at 5 %). Plugging in resets them.

settings.label: Stays for
settings.description: How long the warning stays. 0 = until you click it.

settings.label: Width
settings.description: Width of the warning.

settings.label: Battery size
settings.description: Size of the red battery.

settings.label: Battery icon
settings.description: Icon file in assets/icons.

settings.label: Percent to battery gap
settings.description: Space between the percentage and the battery icon at the right end.

settings.label: Title
settings.description: Title of the warning.

settings.label: Power saver icon
settings.description: Icon of the power saver badge at the left end. Click it to turn power saver on.

settings.label: Pulse speed
settings.description: How long one slow pulse of the battery takes.

settings.label: Pulse depth
settings.description: How faint the battery gets at the bottom of a pulse. 1 = no pulse.

sections.title: Charging alert
sections.description: The alert that pops up when you plug the charger in.

settings.label: Show when plugged in
settings.description: Pop up in the island when the charger is plugged in.

settings.label: How long it stays
settings.description: How long the charging alert stays up.

settings.label: Width
settings.description: Width of the charging alert.

settings.label: Percent to battery gap
settings.description: Space between the percentage and the battery (the battery is the idle island's, same size).

settings.label: Title
settings.description: Text while charging.

settings.label: Full text
settings.description: Text when the battery is already full.

settings.label: Battery fill duration
settings.description: How long the battery takes to fill up to the level when the alert appears.

settings.label: Bolt
settings.description: Once the battery has filled up to its level, the charging bolt pops in on its right end, like in the idle island (same look: idle.battery.badge).

sections.title: Wi-Fi connected alert
sections.description: Shown in the island when you join a Wi-Fi network.

settings.label: Show the alert
settings.description: Show the network name in the island when you connect to Wi-Fi.

settings.label: Stays for
settings.description: How long the alert stays.

settings.label: Maximum width
settings.description: Longer network names are cut with an ellipsis.

settings.label: Minimum width
settings.description: The alert is never narrower than this, even for a short network name.

settings.label: Icon size
settings.description: Size of the Wi-Fi icon.

settings.label: Status text
settings.description: Shown under the network name.

settings.label: Bar delay
settings.description: The Wi-Fi bars light up one after the other: time between two bars.

settings.label: Bar fade
settings.description: How long each bar takes to light up.

sections.title: Headphones alert
sections.description: Shown in the island when headphones (Bluetooth, USB or a jack) become the sound output.

settings.label: Show the alert
settings.description: Show the device name in the island when headphones connect.

settings.label: Stays for
settings.description: How long the alert stays.

settings.label: Icon size
settings.description: Size of the headphones icon.

settings.label: Icon
settings.description: Icon file in assets/icons.

settings.label: Status text
settings.description: Shown in green on the right.

settings.label: Minimum width
settings.description: The alert is never narrower than this, even for a short device name.

settings.label: Maximum width
settings.description: Long device names are cut with "…" past this width.

settings.label: Icon bounce start
settings.description: Size the icon starts at before it bounces in.

settings.label: Icon bounce
settings.description: Spring of the icon's bounce. Lower damping bounces more.

sections.title: Music alert
sections.description: Shown in the island when music starts, like the iPhone: the album cover at the left, the bars at the right in the cover's color. Click it for the media panel.

settings.label: Show the alert
settings.description: Show the cover and the bars in the island when music starts.

settings.label: Stays for
settings.description: How long the alert stays.

settings.label: Only after a break of
settings.description: The alert shows only if nothing played for this long before. So the next song of a playlist, or playing again after a short pause, doesn't show it again.

settings.label: Width
settings.description: Width of the alert (the cover and the bars sit at its two ends).

settings.label: Space around the cover
settings.description: Space between the cover and the island's top, bottom and left edges (the cover gets smaller as this grows; the island keeps its height).

settings.label: Bars
settings.description: How many bars.

settings.label: Bar height
settings.description: Height of the bars at their tallest.

settings.label: Note size
settings.description: Without a cover: size of the music note on its tile (share of the tile).

settings.label: Cover bounce start
settings.description: Size the cover starts at before it bounces in.

settings.label: Cover bounce
settings.description: Spring of the cover's bounce. Lower damping bounces more.

sections.title: Notifications
sections.description: App notifications, shown in the secondary island.

settings.label: Width
settings.description: Width of a notification.

settings.label: Padding
settings.description: Space between the edges and the content.

settings.label: Spacing
settings.description: Space between the picture and the text, and between the title and its age or close button.

settings.label: Line spacing
settings.description: Space between the lines of a notification.

settings.label: Picture size
settings.description: Size of the picture or app icon at the left. Its corners follow the island's rounded end.

settings.label: Default icon
settings.description: Icon on a soft tile when the notification has no picture and its app no icon.

settings.label: Urgent icon
settings.description: Icon on a red tile for urgent notifications (a full disk, a failing battery) that have no picture or app icon.

settings.label: App icon on pictures
settings.description: When a notification has a picture (a person, a cover), the app's icon sits small on its bottom-right corner, cut into it. Its size.

settings.label: App icon cut
settings.description: The space cut out of the picture around the app's icon.

settings.label: App icon overhang
settings.description: How far the app's icon reaches past the picture's corner.

settings.label: Show the app's name
settings.description: Always write the app's name in grey above the title. Off: only when nothing else says who it's from (no app icon, no picture).

settings.label: Small text size
settings.description: Text size of the app's name (when shown) and of how long ago it arrived.

settings.label: Title size
settings.description: Text size of the notification's title, in white.

settings.label: Text size
settings.description: Text size of the message, in grey under the title.

settings.label: Text weight
settings.description: How bold the message text is (400 = regular, 700 = bold).

settings.label: Lines when open
settings.description: How many lines of text show when you hover a notification (closed: one).

settings.label: Show its age after
settings.description: A notification that waited this long to be seen (for example behind a panel you had open) says how long ago it arrived. 0 = never.

settings.label: Minutes ago
settings.description: How long it has been waiting, after the title (only once it's older than "Show its age after"). %1 is the number of minutes.

groups.title: Arrival
groups.description: How a notification comes in, once the island has opened for it.

settings.label: Icon starts at
settings.description: The size the icon springs up from, compared to its own. 1 = no spring.

settings.label: Icon spring
settings.description: How the icon springs up to its size.

settings.label: Text delay
settings.description: How long after the icon the text starts coming in.

settings.label: Text duration
settings.description: How long the text takes to fade and rise in.

settings.label: Text rise
settings.description: How far the text rises as it comes in.

settings.label: Buttons
settings.description: Most buttons shown for one notification.

settings.label: Button height
settings.description: Height of the notification's buttons.

settings.label: Button padding
settings.description: Space on each side of a button's text.

settings.label: Button spacing
settings.description: Space between buttons.

settings.label: Space above buttons
settings.description: Space between the text and the buttons.

settings.label: Button tint
settings.description: How visible the buttons and close button are.

settings.label: Button hover tint
settings.description: How visible a button is under the mouse.

settings.label: Close button size
settings.description: Size of the round close button.

settings.label: Close icon size
settings.description: Size of the cross inside the close button.

settings.label: Close icon
settings.description: Icon of the close button.

settings.label: Show notifications
settings.description: Show app notifications in the island. Off: apps still send them, but nothing pops up.

settings.label: Stays for
settings.description: How long a notification stays when the app doesn't say.

settings.label: Use the app's time
settings.description: Apps can ask for their notification to stay a given time; follow it.

settings.label: Urgent ones stay for
settings.description: How long urgent notifications (low battery...) stay. 0 = until you close them.

settings.label: Show low-priority
settings.description: Show notifications that apps mark as unimportant.

settings.label: Newest first
settings.description: When several notifications are waiting, show the newest first instead of in order.

settings.label: Open on hover
settings.description: Hovering a notification shows all its text and its buttons.

settings.label: Click closes it
settings.description: Clicking a notification closes it after opening what it points to.

settings.label: Switch fade
settings.description: Fade between two notifications that follow each other.

settings.label: Urgent ones break through Focus
settings.description: While Focus (do not disturb, in quick settings) is on, notifications aren't shown, except urgent ones (an app marks them critical) when this is on.

groups.title: Clicking a notification
groups.description: Where a click takes you: the notification's own action, then the window that sent it.

settings.label: Bring up its window
settings.description: Clicking a notification brings the window that sent it to the front: the app's window, or the terminal a command sent it from.

settings.label: Open the app if it's closed
settings.description: When the app that sent a notification has no window open (and the notification can't open anything itself), clicking it starts the app.

settings.label: System ones open Settings
settings.description: Clicking a notification from the system (network, Bluetooth, printers, power, sound, updates) opens the matching page of the Settings app.

settings.label: System senders
settings.description: Which senders count as the system, and the Settings page each one opens: the sender's name in lower case with only letters and digits ("NetworkManager" -> "networkmanager") and the page's name.

settings.label: Parent processes followed
settings.description: How far up from the process that sent a notification to look for a window (a command run in a terminal: the command, its shell, the terminal).

settings.label: Windows command
settings.description: Command that lists the open windows as JSON (id, app id, process id, last focus).

settings.label: Focus command
settings.description: Command that brings a window to the front: {id} is replaced by the window's id.

sections.title: Screenshot alert
sections.description: When you take a screenshot, the island shows the picture itself; click it to open it.

settings.label: Show screenshots
settings.description: Show the screenshot you just took in the island (click to open it in your image viewer). Off: the usual "Screenshot captured" notification.

settings.label: Shown for
settings.description: How long the screenshot stays before the island closes. Hovering it keeps it.

settings.label: Screenshot notifications
settings.description: The titles of the notifications that announce a screenshot (niri says "Screenshot captured").

settings.label: Screenshots folder
settings.description: Where your screenshots are saved: the screenshots panel lists this folder, and the pop-up looks there for the picture when the notification doesn't say which file it is (the newest file saved just now).

settings.label: Just now
settings.description: How recent a file in the screenshots folder must be to count as the screenshot just taken.

groups.title: Layout
groups.description: The picture keeps the screenshot's proportions, as a card with small corners held in a lot of island.

settings.label: Picture height
settings.description: How tall the picture is (wide screenshots are made smaller to stay under the width below).

settings.label: Picture width at most
settings.description: The widest the picture gets.

settings.label: Picture roundness
settings.description: How round the picture's corners are, as a share of its height, so a bigger picture gets rounder corners in the same proportion. 0 = square, 0.5 = fully round ends.

settings.label: Island roundness
settings.description: How round the island's corners are around the picture, compared to its usual corners (your corner style). 1 = as usual, 1.5 = half as round again. Never rounder than a full oval.

settings.label: Space at the sides
settings.description: Island to the left and right of the picture.

settings.label: Space above and below
settings.description: Island above and under the picture.

settings.label: Hover growth
settings.description: How much the picture grows under the pointer (1 = not at all).

settings.label: Starts at
settings.description: The size the picture springs up from when it shows, compared to its own.

settings.label: Spring
settings.description: How the picture springs up to its size.

sections.title: Goodbye
sections.description: When the computer powers off or restarts, the island writes "bye bye" by hand before the screen goes dark.

settings.label: Say goodbye
settings.description: Write "bye bye" in the island when the computer powers off or restarts, however it was started (the launcher, the power button, a command). The computer waits for it, a few seconds at most. Off = it goes down right away.

settings.label: Wait before writing
settings.description: Time for the island to take its shape (and the launcher to close) before the writing starts.

settings.label: Writing time
settings.description: How long writing "bye bye" takes. Keep the waiting, the writing and the pause under 5 seconds: after that the computer powers off anyway.

settings.label: Pause after writing
settings.description: How long "bye bye" stays once written, before the computer goes down.

settings.label: Longest wait
settings.description: The computer never waits longer than this for the goodbye, even if something goes wrong. The system itself stops waiting after 5 seconds (logind's InhibitDelayMaxSec).

settings.label: Handwriting
settings.description: The drawing that's written, from assets/handwriting. Its lines are drawn in order, like a pen.

settings.label: Writing height
settings.description: Height of the handwriting, from the top of the tallest letter to the bottom of the lowest one. Its width follows.

settings.label: Line thickness
settings.description: Thickness of the handwritten line.

settings.label: Side space
settings.description: Space between the handwriting and the island's left and right edges.

settings.label: Top and bottom space
settings.description: Space between the handwriting and the island's top and bottom edges.

sections.title: Sounds
sections.description: Short, soft sounds for what's worth hearing when you're not looking: notifications and alerts. Never for clicks, panels or the music controls. Silent while Focus is on (low battery excepted) and when the sound is muted.

settings.label: Sounds
settings.description: Play the island's sounds at all. Off = it stays silent.

settings.label: Volume
settings.description: How loud the island's sounds are, on top of the system volume.

settings.label: Quiet during Focus
settings.description: No sounds while Focus (do not disturb) is on, except the low battery warning.

settings.label: Minimum gap
settings.description: A sound right after another is skipped (several notifications at once make one sound).

settings.label: Notifications
settings.description: Play a short sound when a notification arrives.

settings.label: Notifications sound
settings.description: The sound file (in assets/sounds; made by tools/make-sounds.py) played when a notification arrives.

settings.label: Low battery
settings.description: Play a short sound when the battery runs low.

settings.label: Low battery sound
settings.description: The sound file (in assets/sounds; made by tools/make-sounds.py) played when the battery runs low.

settings.label: Charging
settings.description: Play a short sound when the charger is plugged in.

settings.label: Charging sound
settings.description: The sound file (in assets/sounds; made by tools/make-sounds.py) played when the charger is plugged in.

settings.label: Headphones
settings.description: Play a short sound when headphones or a speaker connect.

settings.label: Headphones sound
settings.description: The sound file (in assets/sounds; made by tools/make-sounds.py) played when headphones or a speaker connect.

settings.label: Wi-Fi connected
settings.description: Play a short sound when the computer joins a Wi-Fi network.

settings.label: Wi-Fi connected sound
settings.description: The sound file (in assets/sounds; made by tools/make-sounds.py) played when the computer joins a Wi-Fi network.

sections.title: System
sections.description: How the shell listens to the system. You normally never need to change these.

settings.label: Audio check delay
settings.description: After an audio change (plugging headphones, a Bluetooth headset connecting), wait this long for things to settle before checking which output is in use. Several events usually arrive at once; this checks once for all of them.

settings.label: Event listener restart delay
settings.description: If a system event listener stops (for example the audio server restarted), wait this long before starting it again.

settings.label: Quiet start
settings.description: Right after the shell starts, Wi-Fi and headphones that are already connected don't pop up as new connections. This is how long that lasts.

settings.label: Save delay
settings.description: Saved state (the launcher's pins) is written this long after it last changed, so dragging a tile around doesn't write the file at every step.
